description: With no `id`, make a project, after find_projects shows none fits: a `title` and a short `description`, and its `repo` when it has one. Leave out `team` for a private one, and pass a team slug only when the person wants it shared; `parent` puts it inside another, in that one's space. With `id`, change its title, description, repo ("" for none), colour or place (`parent` "" for the top level); its space never changes. The answer's `space` says where it is: tell the person.

description.description: what it is for, in a line

id.description: the project to change; leave out to make one

parent.description: project to put it inside; "" for the top level

repo.description: the repo it is built from, e.g. github.com/acme/billing; "" for none

team.description: new project only: team slug; omit for private

title.description: name of the product or body of work

name: save_project
title: Save a project
